title: S8 Deprecated Classification Use
governing_clause: S8.4 Classification Systems / S8.6 Data Consistency & Integrity
test_intent: Verify that active project information does not rely on deprecated or superseded classification systems, code sets, codes, mappings, or carriers unless a governed transition/deviation explicitly permits that use.

applicability.applies_when: Classification is present in the tested information and the governing registry provides lifecycle status/effective-version information.

required_evidence: Registry lifecycle status and applicable version/effective condition

result_logic.pass: Observed classification references are active for the tested context, or any legacy/deprecated use is explicitly covered by a governed transition/deviation.
result_logic.fail: Active information uses a deprecated/superseded system, code set, code, mapping, or carrier without an approved transition/deviation.
result_logic.not_applicable: No classification is present or no lifecycle status applies to the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: Classification is present but lifecycle status/version/effective-date evidence cannot be resolved.

provenance.derived_from: page 4423719 Classification Registry & Protocol Governance Scaffold; REQ-S8-011
provenance.migration_note: Derived from VC-002 concept and the S8 requirement to preserve semantic integrity over time.
